profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full-Stack & Cloud | React, GraphQL, AWS | Security SaaS
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.

I currently work on a cybersecurity SaaS platform, where I own features end-to-end—from frontend architecture and backend APIs to cloud infrastructure and third-party integrations.

My strengths are in designing GraphQL APIs, building cloud-native systems on AWS, and improving developer experience through better tooling, schemas, and performance practices. I enjoy working on complex, ambiguous problems and making pragmatic architectural decisions that balance performance, security, and maintainability.

Recent work includes building real-time, AI-powered product features using OpenAI APIs, designing secure ServiceNow integrations, and leading performance and schema improvements adopted across the engineering team.

I’m known for taking ownership, unblocking stalled work, and collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering to ship reliable, customer-focused solutions.

Currently open to senior or staff-leaning roles where I can contribute to backend architecture, cloud systems, and scalable product development.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior engineer on a cybersecurity SaaS platform serving enterprise customers.

- Led development of core security analytics features enabling customers to assess and benchmark security posture over time.

- Designed and delivered secure third-party integrations (ServiceNow, Contentful, acquisitions), coordinating frontend, backend, and AWS infrastructure.

- Architected and enhanced a real-time AI-powered detection advisor using OpenAI APIs, GraphQL subscriptions, SQS, and Lambda, migrating from SSE to a more scalable and secure approach.

- Built and maintained a custom design system on top of Material UI, improving UI consistency and developer productivity.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Web developer responsible for building custom features, fixing bugs, and improving performance of the website. 
- Applied various techniques to improve site speed including image optimizations, font loading strategies, delaying JS loading, refactoring CSS, and setting an efficient cache control policy. These strategies and more improved PageSpeed Insights to over 90, WebpageTest score to all As and GTMetrix score to all As.
- Set up Gitlab CI/CD with project that greatly improved developer cooperation and code reviews, thus both increasing developer morale and significantly reducing bugs
- Added two security scans (sast and dast) to Gitlab workflow that has caught and prevented security flaws.
- Participated in major rebrand project for company that involved building custom blocks, custom views, and custom Twig templates.
- Continuously monitor and improve website by constantly reviewing code, refactoring code, removing unused code, and making various suggestions.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Interfaces · PHP · HTML · Communication · JSON · Web Applications · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Front-End Development · Debugging · Software Development · PHP Applications

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Front end developer taking custom mock ups from designer and collaborating with other front end and back end developers as well as team lead to developer custom web app that helped foreign exchange students find housing in the United States.
- Build custom templates provided by designer using HTML, CSS, JS, and PHP
- Participate in design and development iterations throughout the lifetime of the app
- Set up and write automated tests using Cypress.io
- Help other departments with their technical needs
